602-3017-4691.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
602-3017-4691.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability, causing Ghostly Pilferer to be unblockable this turn
Repeat

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4289-6073--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-6073--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1011-2728-5256-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-5256-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-5256-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1987-2020-2239.easyPrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
Vadrik has at least 2 power.
1987-2020-2239.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2020-2239.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

3249-5173-5542-6797.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

3821-4518-5542.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
3821-4518-5542.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1115-3094-4659-5390-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1115-3094-4659-5390-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

628-5686-7200.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reluctant Dounguard.
When Reluctant Dounguard dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1251-1563-3899-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

851-4017-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-4017-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

1594-2034-4871-5795-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Helm of Awakening.
Repeat.

2281-5231-6132.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3175-3605-3967-4812.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-5078-5231-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

985-2757-5051-5078.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Traxos, untapping a basic land.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

678-5147-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
678-5147-6749.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, causing you to return Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Anticausal Vestige trigger, causing you to reveal the top cards of your library and put it into your graveyard if its a creature card, or draw a card otherwise, and then put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4068-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
4068-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
4068-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

413-2060-2946-6701.easyPrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
413-2060-2946-6701.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
413-2060-2946-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

856-2921-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1270-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating three tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers three times, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

38-301-5805.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-301-5805.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Gev.
Repeat.

2440-3464-4183-4720.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Hyrax Tower Scout
2440-3464-4183-4720.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Hyrax Tower Scout with haste.
When the token Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Hyrax Tower Scout trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Hyrax Tower Scout, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Hyrax Tower Scout for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Stonework Packbeast twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

222-527-969-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-969-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1621-5400.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Synth Infiltrator.
1621-5400.description:
Cast Synth Infiltrator by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Synth Infiltrator enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Synth Infiltrator. Choose to have Synth Infiltrator enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

654-1409-2895-3478.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
654-1409-2895-3478.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Holding priority, activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

235-4651-5438.description:
Cast Explosive Singularity by paying at most {8}{R}{R}, dealing 10 damage to any creature.
Imodane triggers, giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

360-1981-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
360-1981-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

774-2137-4923.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
774-2137-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Cabal Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Cabal Ritual, adding at least {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have seven or more cards in your graveyard, this combo nets infinite black mana.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other instant and/or sorcery spell on the stack to get infinite copies of them.

uses.n: Cyclonus, the Saboteur // Cyclonus, Cybertronian Fighter

2011-3898.notablePrerequisites:
Cyclonus has power 5 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
Permanents you control can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
An opponent cannot block Cyclonus.
2011-3898.description:
Declare Cyclonus, the Saboteur as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Cyclonus, the Saboteur.
Cyclonus triggers, causing it to connive and convert it to Cyclonus, Cybertronian Fighter.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Cyclonus, Cybertronian Fighter as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Cyclonus.
Cyclonus triggers, causing you to convert it to Cyclonus, the Saboteur and to get an additional beginning phase after this one.
Move to your beginning phase, causing you to untap all permanents you control.
Move to your next combat phase.
Repeat.
